headline: 3 Reasons SOLV is Risky and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
summary: Since January 2026, Solventum has been in a holding pattern, posting a small loss of 2.2% while floating around $77.29. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 7.9% gain during that period.
